purpose: Teach: 王道/東京タワー/大相撲/バッター/金メダル/声優/ジョギング/レア

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、王道、絶対、ロマンス映画、絶対、好きよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm serious, Aoi — I absolutely love a good traditional romance film.
lines.style: Warm and sincere, leaning forward slightly. Soft opening. Genuine conviction on 'absolutely love,' not performed. Eyes steady on her, checking if she understands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、東京タワー、絶対、夜景、絶対、最高だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm telling you, the Tokyo Tower view at night was absolutely stunning.
lines.style: Bright and animated, gesturing openly. Quick pace, genuine excitement bubbling through. Leans back, eyes wide. Infectious energy — she wants Mei to feel it too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、大相撲、絶対、観戦、絶対、行きたいな、メイちゃん
lines.en: Honestly, I'd really love to go see a sumo tournament someday.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. A little slower. Sincere longing underneath — not demanding, just expressing a quiet wish. Gentle trailing-off, like sharing a secret dream.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、野球の、本気で、絶対、バッター、絶対、すごかったよ、メイちゃん、本気for
lines.en: The baseball player we saw was genuinely incredible.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but grounded. Quick delivery on 'incredible,' then a beat of reflection. Nodding slightly. She wants Mei to know she's noticed something real, not just swept up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、金メダル、絶対、選手、絶対、お店、絶対、来てくれたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Can you believe that gold-medal athlete actually came by the shop?
lines.style: Animated and slightly disbelieving. Quick pace, eyebrows up. Wonder mixed with pride — amazement that this happened in her small corner. Voice lifts slightly on the question.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お気に入りの、本気で、絶対、声優、絶対、ラジオ、絶対、聴いてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been listening to that voice actor's radio show — it's become my favorite.
lines.style: Warm and engaged. Steady, conversational pace. A small smile in the voice. She's sharing something she enjoys, inviting Mei into it, not boasting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、毎朝、絶対、続けてるの、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm actually keeping up with my morning jogs pretty consistently now.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly vulnerable. Not rushing. A note of quiet pride, but also the effort behind it. She's telling Mei something that took work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、レア、絶対、なコーヒー豆、絶対、お店に入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I just got some really rare coffee beans in for the shop.
lines.style: Animated and engaged. Warm opening. Slight lift on 'rare' — she's proud of the find. Quick, eager pace. She wants Mei to feel her genuine enthusiasm for the small good things.
